build_annotate_fx_graph: build an FX graph transformer that annotates node types using Python function signatures from torch.nn modules and functional calls
test_annotate_functionals: test the AnnotateTypesWithSchema transformer with annotate_functionals enabled to annotate torch.nn.functional call nodes with return types
test_annotate_modules: test the AnnotateTypesWithSchema transformer with annotate_modules enabled to annotate torch.nn module forward method return types
test_annotate_get_attrs: test the AnnotateTypesWithSchema transformer with annotate_get_attrs enabled to annotate get_attr nodes with inferred TorchScript types
review_extract_return_type: review the _extract_python_return_type method that extracts Python return annotations from callable targets using inspect.signature
